#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""CLI with pyproject.toml configuration support using cyclopts."""

import cyclopts


app = cyclopts.App(
    config_path="pyproject.toml",
    config_dict_key="tool.mycli",
)


@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hello",
    count: int = 1,
    verbose: bool = False,
) -> None:
    """Greet someone with customizable options.
    
    Args:
        name: Name to greet
        greeting: Greeting word to use
        count: How many times to greet
        verbose: Enable verbose output
    """
    for i in range(count):
        message = f"{greeting}, {name}!"
        if verbose:
            message += f" (greeting #{i + 1})"
        print(message)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
